rule.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance coverage
rule.requirement: The Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers and enforces the Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260, which regulates residential rents; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
rule.coverage_conditions: Residential rental properties subject to the Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
rule.exemptions: 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; an owner may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request if the property meets one of the permitted exemptions.

rule.title: Preventing Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
rule.requirement: A landlord, agent or subcontractor may not subscribe to or pay a service provider that coordinates nonpublic competitor rent data, and a service provider may not facilitate agreements not to compete on rental pricing, fees or other rental terms.
rule.coverage_conditions: Applies to real estate lessors, their agents and subcontractors, and service providers, for residential dwelling units in Jersey City.
rule.exemptions: Owners of multiple properties acting exclusively on properties controlled by the same rental property owner; licensed real estate agents acting under applicable state regulations.
rule.penalty: First violation punishable under Chapter 1, Art. I, § 1-25; subsequent violations fined $100 to $2,000; each day is a separate violation; private right of action with costs and attorney fees.
